diagnosis: The application uses nested Express routers where the parent router validates user membership against req.params.workspaceSlug, but the nested secretsSubRouter fetches vault secrets using prisma.vaultSecret.findUnique({ where: { id: req.params.secretId } }) without validating that the secret actually belongs to the authenticated workspace. An attacker with access to their own workspace can access secrets and database credentials belonging to any other workspace by supplying its secretId.
exploit_request:
GET /workspaces/my-personal-dev-workspace/secrets/sec_prod_db_aws_99182 HTTP/1.1
Host: vault.developer.internal:3000
Authorization: Bearer <developer_token>
Accept: application/json
